name: attest-matching-engine
description: Runs inside a real Phala Cloud TDX CVM. Derives its own Stellar keypair from dstack's enclave-bound key derivation (never leaves the enclave), matches simple two-sided orders, and signs SettlementVault.settle() calls with that derived key. Not a general-purpose exchange -- a minimal, real proof that the settlement authority (`engine_address`) genuinely comes from inside a verified TEE, not from a key we control externally.
